checks.name: A/B concurrent requests pin the same capability but cannot read each other
idempotent retry returns one request; different input or channel conflicts
stable publication requires successful test of the exact draft digest
draft changes cannot mutate queued stable requests; real Git rollback
revision conflict prevents lost updates
knowledge is reviewed into draft only; stable and prior snapshots remain unchanged
disabled learning and cross-task source are rejected
schedules persist the scheduler computed next instant in Shanghai time and fire once
export excludes run history, example input, MCP connections and custom key env
invalid paths, shell fields and MCP credentials in URLs are rejected
queued cancellation and failure produce distinct persisted status
timeout is enforced and sensitive error text is redacted
restart interrupts unfinished runs without replaying side effects
archiving preserves evidence and explicitly includes archived history
user-defined learning rules create deduplicated proposals without copying request context
Pi custom tool bridge invokes only configured MCP allowlist (real local MCP, mocked model)
HTTP clients use isolated session capabilities and stable-only validated submission
search returns stable services, unmatched plans fall back locally, drafts stay hidden
cross-origin requests, DNS rebinding, malformed schema and oversized input are rejected
API authentication is required when configured, with Unicode-safe comparisons
official MCP Streamable HTTP client discovers, opens, submits and retrieves real results
official MCP stdio client is a thin client to the same isolation service
independent registry round-trip validates digest, sanitizes export, and installs draft only
HTTP task composition, fork, typed human answers and durable receipt protocol keep session isolation
Pi runner completes serial Team stages using actual SDK with mocked model responses; no live model claim
actual Pi SDK initializes fresh sessions without ambient AGENTS, tools, skills or history (offline contract)
actual Pi tool allowlist contains only explicitly passed tools, no read/bash/write
narrowed Mandate hides disallowed tools and never connects their MCP server (actual SDK, mocked model)
real restart makes committed tool receipts available to the resumed executor without rerunning the action
real SIGKILL/restart resumes a durable queued/running Run with the original capability and own checkpoint
real crash after external success before receipt waits for reconciliation and does not repeat the action
authorization can narrow but cannot expand; input text cannot grant a tool or child
task DAG shares pinned child capability while parent request trees and input projections remain private
cycle rejection and fork provenance do not mutate a shared child or existing parent version
a composite task can consist entirely of child capabilities without a redundant local checklist
human waiting survives store reopen; typed answers resume the same Run with a new Attempt
revocation is persistent and stops waiting descendants from being answered or retried
Outbox is transactionally coupled; lease loss redelivers one ID and ACK/NACK are scoped and durable
failure to write an Outbox rolls back terminal business state
archive projection failure cannot undo committed result/delivery and is rebuilt from SQLite
provider secrets are redacted from checkpoints and results, not just errors
multiple open questions must all be answered before dispatch resumes
an expired Attempt is fenced off after a replacement claim
descendant tool calls share the root budget and completed receipts are reused

realProcessCrash.sideEffect: local file stand-in; not a live external business service

nativeDesktop.layer: native macOS Chrome UI automation; not human or physical-phone acceptance

limits: no OS sandbox or cloud multi-tenant guarantee
